fixture.description: Immutable, privacy-safe illustrative classroom. Not a Notion or Drive projection.

lesson.learning_target: I can place a focal point on a thirds line and explain how it changes balance.
lesson.daily_focus: Compare a centered and an off-center composition of the same scene.

items.title: Harbor, subject centered
items.alt_text: Illustration: a lighthouse in the middle of the frame.

items.title: Harbor, subject on a thirds line
items.alt_text: Illustration: the same lighthouse on the right thirds line with open sky to the left.
items.rationale: Same scene, so only placement differs.

items.title: Harbor, tilted horizon
items.alt_text: Illustration: the same scene with a tilted horizon.

steps.prompt: Look at both harbor illustrations. Name the focal point in each.
steps.check_for_understanding: Every student points to the lighthouse in both.

steps.prompt: With a partner, say which picture feels more balanced and why. Use: In picture __, I notice __.
steps.check_for_understanding: Listen for the words focal point and balance.

steps.prompt: Sketch a thumbnail that moves the focal point to a thirds line.
steps.check_for_understanding: Thumbnail shows the subject on a grid line, not the center.
